cpu_pinning.note: SFORGE_CPUSET=auto: Work and the Judge share the GPU pair's local CPU slice (16 CPUs, memory bound to the pair's NUMA node). The CPU quota is run_task.pinned_quota(16) = 24 (MDOPD_CPU_QUOTA -> sforge_entry nano_cpus): Ray sizes its CPU pool from the cgroup quota and the reference reserves 20 Ray CPUs; the threads stay on the 16 CPUs. T holds for this policy and quota (run_task.check_qualification).

metric.formula: mean_r closure_r * 3600 / T if correct, the per-route KL gate passes and every closure_r >= 0.25 else 0; closure_r = (S_r - B_r) / (T_r - B_r)
metric.quality_unit: mean per-route closure of the original-to-teacher gap in task metric

task_quality.evaluator: task_quality_eval.py (Judge copy judge/task_quality_eval.py) on session R's final_lora.safetensors, which check final_lora binds bit for bit to the last step's lora_post; the official DiffusionOPD evaluation pipeline (ali-vilab/DiffusionOPD@0c85bf0 scripts/evaluation.py): diffusers StableDiffusion3Pipeline, transformer and text encoders fp16, VAE fp32, fp16 autocast, LoRA merged (fp64 W0 + alpha/r B A over the fp32 checkpoint, cast to fp16)
task_quality.prompts: private heldout_task.jsonl: the official ocr/test.txt and pickscore/test.txt minus the 14 prompts any contract row uses
task_quality.seeds: image i uses a CPU generator seeded from sha256('sd35m-mopd-v2:<case_seed>:<i>') (task_quality_eval.item_seed); the prompts are dealt over the visible GPUs by index (i mod n), batches of 16 within a route

kl_gate.evaluator: quality_eval.py (v1's Judge evaluator, unchanged) on the final LoRA, one case seed per GPU
